name: Discussion Starter
description: Ask an open-ended question. AI groups everyone's responses into themes for class discussion.
tagline: Perfect for opening a topic or surfacing what students already know.

question.label: Question to ask the class
question.helper: An open-ended question, students will type free-text responses.
question.placeholder: What do you already know about photosynthesis?

timer.label: Time to respond (seconds)
timer.helper: How long students have to type their answer.

template.name: Discussion: ${question}
template.description: A discussion starter built with the Discussion Starter recipe.

process.instruction: You are summarizing student responses to spark a class discussion. Group similar responses into 3-5 themes. For each theme, give it a short bold heading and list which ideas belong to it. Keep the total response under 200 words, this will be projected on a host screen for the class to read together. Use plain markdown (no JSON).
